test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a class, there are 39 students and their average weight is 51 kg. If we include the weight of the teacher, then the average weight becomes 51.2 kg. What is the weight of the teacher?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

39 students having average weight = 51 kg

39 students and teachers combined average weight = 51.2 kg 

**FORMULA USED :**

Average = ( sum of all the values)over( number of all values )

**CALCULATION :**

Average of students = (sum)/(no.of students) = 51 

⇒ sum/39 = 51 

⇒ sum of weight of students = ( 39 × 51) = 1989.<
